name: Shark EZ Robot Vacuum with Self-Empty Base (RV912S / RV9124S3US)
description: Selling a Shark EZ Robot Vacuum (Model RV9124S3US / RV912S) with its companion bagless self-emptying base. It features row-by-row methodical cleaning, Wi-Fi connectivity for app scheduling, and a base that holds up to 30 days of dust and pet hair. It is in FAIR condition, showing visible scuffs, scratches, and typical wear on the outer plastic bumper from navigating furniture, but it remains fully operational. Includes the vacuum, self-empty dock, power cable, and installed brushes/filter. May need a replacement filter or side brushes soon depending on preference.
meta_description: Buy a used Shark EZ Robot Vacuum with Self-Empty Base (RV9124S3US) in fair condition. Fully functional automated home cleaning at a heavy discount.
